exclusions.name: Bank supervisor Elena Cruz
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection rate or shipping schedule, so her actions do not affect the number of units received.

exclusions.name: Other hospitals or blood centres
exclusions.why_safe: The question only concerns St. Vincent regional hospital and Cascade regional blood centre. Other entities are not part of the causal chain.

exclusions.name: Weekend collections (Saturday/Sunday)
exclusions.why_safe: The drive is only open Monday to Friday, and the week under consideration is Monday to Friday. Weekend collections are irrelevant.

uncertainties.meaning: The exact number of units the hospital holds at Friday noon is unknown because hospital usage of blood units between Monday morning and Friday noon is not specified.
The rate or amount of blood usage at the hospital is unknown; it could affect the final count.

Whether the centre has at least 150 units to ship on Tuesday depends on Monday's collection and initial stock; Monday's collection is 12 units/hour for 8 hours = 96 units, so initial 40 + 96 = 136, which is less than 150. Thus the centre may not have enough stock for a full 150-unit shipment on Tuesday. The evidence does not specify if partial shipments are allowed or if the centre can use stock from other sources.

After Tuesday's shipment (if any), the centre's stock depends on collections on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday before 4pm. The exact timing and amount of collections on those days is uncertain because the drive operates 9-5 each day, but the shipment at 4pm may not include all of that day's collection if collection continues after 4pm. Also, if Tuesday's shipment was less than 150, the centre's stock may be different.
It is uncertain whether a shipment of 150 units (or any) is dispatched on Tuesday because the centre may not have enough stock.
Similarly uncertain due to stock levels.

If dispatched, the shipment takes 3 hours, so if dispatched at 4pm, it arrives at 7pm Tuesday. But the deadline is Friday noon, so it would be received before deadline. However, the exact receipt time is not critical.
If dispatched at 4pm Thursday, arrives 7pm Thursday, before Friday noon.
